rules.statement: Don't report a removed `justify-self`/`align-self` declaration as a layout regression when the grid item fills its track (for example `width: 100%` with a `max-width` larger than the track at every breakpoint), because the alignment has no free space to act on.
rules.why: The maintainer declined such a finding: the drawing kept `width: 100%` and `max-width: 26rem`, the column was always narrower than 26rem, so `justify-self` had nothing to move, and renders before and after were identical.
rules.check: Before reporting, look at the item's remaining `width`/`max-width` and the grid track sizes at each breakpoint. Report only if the item can be narrower than its track, so that removing the alignment actually moves it.
